threads.body: Metadata keys can overwrite reserved schema keys like `"content"` and `"id"` because the metadata dict is merged last. This can corrupt the document payload and semconv mapping (e.g., a metadata field named `"content"` replaces `doc.page_content`). Filter out reserved keys from metadata before merging (or nest metadata under a dedicated key like `"metadata"`), ensuring `"content"`/`"id"` remain authoritative.

threads.body: This PR’s code imports and relies on `RetrievalInvocation` (and `telemetry_handler.retrieval(...)` behavior). The declared lower bound should be the first `opentelemetry-util-genai` release that actually provides those APIs; otherwise, users installing the minimum version can hit import/runtime errors. Please bump the minimum version accordingly (to the exact version where retrieval support was introduced).

This is a mutable default on the class/model field and can lead to shared state across test instances depending on how `BaseRetriever` (pydantic/model) handles defaults. Prefer a per-instance default (e.g., a default factory) to prevent cross-test coupling if the list is ever mutated.

Could you please send an issue (or PR) to update it?

And then just don't fallback to anything, leave it None
